What they did to those people is terryfing. Someone should hear what happened.

The fire brings some relief, but the body is still drained.
Crude, but effective. At least now gathering won’t be such a struggle.
With the right tools ready, more solid materials are finally within reach.

As sad as it is, Robyn has to know the truth.

The wolves are a threat and must be eliminated before they cause more harm.
The wolves are dead. Jeremiah should be pleased.
Jeremiah appreciated your help.
The dog looks hungry. Offering it raw meat might help gain its trust.
Food is the way to the heart after all! The dog has become a faithful companion.
Robyn has suggested going to House Camp. Head there to continue the journey.
The traders are said to be inside the Church.
Speak with the traders at the Church. They will help with the necessary supplies and gear for the trip to the Bunker.
The traders are ready to help. It's time to gear up for the journey to the Bunker.
Make sure to have cold resistance of at least -32, prepare two warming dishes, and gather more rifle ammo before heading to the Bunker.
The preparations are complete. Time to face the cold and journey to the Bunker.
I have to ask Anna about any nearby radio tower so that I can listen to the next message from Icarus.
Looks like someone smashed the radio. I need to repair it and check for any messages from Icarus.
I need to repair the stairs and find the locked room on the roof.
Anna heard Icarus' message and wants to talk about it.
Anna shared blueprints for the new set of clothes.
Anna left me the key to the Church's tower in the room upstairs...
I could use better gear for the journey ahead...
To receive the next signal from Icarus, I have to find Logan. Anna might have an idea how to do just that.
Might need some scrap to fix the walls. Anna told me to ask Sean for some.
I need to tell Anna that I've fixed the walls. All this walking around might've been worth it after all!
Time to secure the walls around House Camp.
I need to disassemble all the junk I got from Sean.
I'll finally be able to cook and enjoy more elaborate meals!
I can use all this scrap to craft new tools.
These tools will help me gather even more resources from around here.
Different ingredient combinations produce dishes with various effects. Time to get cooking!

I found the abandoned radio tower on the outskirts of House Camp. Hopefully I can find Finn there.
Cooking time! Might ask Anna (or Robyn?) for some tips...
Time to give the dishes to Robyn. I should find her in the camp near the place I woke up first.
Report to Anna for some great rewards.

I found a recording from someone named Connie.
Connie's clue points to a specific building. I need to locate it to continue following this trail.

The recording points to a torn-down house at the edge of House Camp. I should investigate that area thoroughly.
Now it's time to gather some clues about Brian's whereabouts.
Anna left some rewards for me in a box nearby. I should collect them.

I need to decide whether to tell Sean about his son's fate.
After that difficult conversation, my work here seems finished. I should get back to Anna.
After discovering the truth about Brian and the Moon Cult, I should report back to Anna.
New Chapter for me

Now to heal my mysterious disease...

I managed to take care of the animals. I should return to the Rat Queen and let her know.

I need to see if my newest bench is working properly.
Could use some ammunition for my newly made weapon.
The Rat Queen wants some of the animals roaming through the Solars killed.

Time to report a job well done.

I recovered the supplies. Time to get them back to Jeremiah.

I want to ask Jeremiah about the Lunar Armor again—time to see if I’ve finally earned his trust.
I reached the outskirts of the Bunker Outpost.
I located the blueprint. I should bring it back to Jeremiah.

The pickaxe works well. Next, I’ll craft an axe.

I need to figure out how to make rope.
